---
title: "Python with MGnipy"
description: "Explore MGnify with its Python client."
---

[MGnipy](https://mgnipy.mgnify.org/) provides Python objects for MGnify studies,
analyses and samples, with pagination, metadata tables and result-download helpers.

```python
from mgnipy import MGnipy

with MGnipy() as mg:
    study = mg.study("MGYS00010393")
    study.get()
    print(study.search_results.to_pandas())
```

[Try the interactive MGnipy demo: list biomes](https://mgnipy.mgnify.org/notebooks/demos/1_mgnify_list_biomes.html).
Choose **Activate Notebook** on that page to run the examples using Binder.

## Running this code in your own environment

Using Python 3.11 or newer, install MGnipy from a terminal:

```bash
python -m pip install mgnipy
```

Then run the Python example above in a notebook or script.
